item.title: Busan Fireworks Festival 2026 Guide — Nov 7 Timetable, How to Get There, Tickets
item.description: The 21st Busan Fireworks Festival takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, across Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaekseom Island. The main show, the Busan Multi Fireworks Show, runs 19:25–19:55. Everything below is based on the official website (busanfireworks.com), checked on November 5, 2026.

item.title: About
item.description: I live in Busan and write practical guides to the city’s festivals, travel and everyday life. Dates and prices are based on official announcements, with sources linked. When details change, posts are updated and the update date is shown.
